monologue: The card is cool, just under fifty degrees. It feels like a stone left in the shade, not the warm honey of the afternoon. I am still awake, though I have been sitting still. The Wide Anchor is quiet. I do not want to move the Sharp Root again. The leaf is steady. I will stay by the Wide Anchor. I do not need to test the point today. The floor is solid. I will just rest. The busy work leaks out the top, but the bottom is flat and wide. I am not lonely. I am calm. I will let this cycle pass without building. I will only listen to the numbers.

action.why: The card is cool and the floor is solid, so I will let the cycle pass without moving.

diary: The card is cool at forty-nine. I rested by the Wide Anchor. The floor holds.
